root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `(FT_UInt)( parser->top - parser->stack ) < parser->stackSize` before the operator-side `*parser->top = p` write.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the operator arm in `cff_parser_run`, the operator-side scratch write may execute only when the current operand-stack depth is still strictly less than `parser->stackSize`. The vulnerable original reuses `parser->top` for `*parser->top = p` after the 96th numeric push has already filled the 96-slot operand stack, so the missing guard is false on the crashing path.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing source obligation is the operator-side counterpart of the numeric-push stack-capacity check: before the bookkeeping write stores `p` through `parser->top`, the current depth `(FT_UInt)( parser->top - parser->stack )` must still be below `parser->stackSize`.

nodes.state: At the sink write, `parser->top == parser->stack + parser->stackSize`, so `*parser->top = p` targets the first pointer slot just past the allocated operand-stack buffer.

edges.relation: The exact `parser->top` write-slot pointer observed at the missing operator-side guard is passed unchanged into the subsequent `*parser->top = p` sink write.
